contract.name: BCI Core Contract
contract.description: Authoritative cross-language runtime contract for BCIAndroid. Kotlin, C++/Oboe, and TypeScript implementations must conform to these semantics even when their language-specific representations differ.

capture.callbackRule: The Oboe real-time callback may copy PCM into preallocated native storage and update lock-free or atomic telemetry only. It must not perform Whisper inference, filesystem I/O, network I/O, JVM calls, unbounded allocation, or blocking waits.

kotlinDrain.ownership: Kotlin drains native PCM after the Oboe callback. Native callback ownership and Kotlin drain ownership must never be reversed.

whisper.rule: Every 44.1 kHz PCM16 inference path must cross the explicit native resamplePcm16To16k boundary before whisper.cpp.

failureRules.behavior: A fatal baseline/audio stall must stop the affected monitoring path safely, preserve the root error code/message, and leave the Android process alive for diagnosis.

jni.methodContract: Every Kotlin external method must have exactly one matching JNI export with the same semantic parameter order and JNI-compatible return/parameter types.

graphics.threadingRule: Rendering runs on the GLSurfaceView render thread. The audio callback must never wait for the render thread.
graphics.lifecycleRule: The GL surface pauses when the Activity is paused and must not retain active rendering work after the monitor surface is detached.

helloAckValidation.rule: Android may enter LIVE only after structurally parsing hello_ack and verifying protocol, streamId, inputCodec, and outputCodec against this contract.

speaker.semantics: neutral best-effort label such as Speaker 1

transcript.priorityRule: Transcript delivery is lower priority than live PCM. Under WebSocket backpressure, transcript messages are dropped before audio.

principles: Never allow the error handler itself to crash the process.
Never perform robust error checks in the Oboe real-time callback.
Preserve the first ERROR/FATAL fault as root cause for the monitoring session.
Preserve the most recent distinct fault separately from root cause.
Coalesce repeated identical faults and increment an occurrence counter instead of flooding logs/UI.
Warnings may degrade health but must not stop healthy audio.
Non-fatal transcription or broadcast failures must not stop local microphone capture.
Fatal native-audio, sample-rate, capture-stall, baseline-stall, or capture-loop failures must stop the affected monitoring path safely.
A fatal worker exception must be caught at the worker boundary rather than escaping and terminating the Android process.

severity.WARNING: Recoverable degradation; continue primary runtime path.
severity.ERROR: Subsystem failure that may disable that subsystem but does not necessarily stop primary audio.
severity.FATAL: Invariant violation or primary audio failure requiring safe shutdown of monitoring.

status.HEALTHY: Current check contains no warning/error/fatal observations.
status.DEGRADED: Current check contains WARNING or non-fatal ERROR observations.
status.ERROR: Current check contains a FATAL observation.

BCI_E_MONITOR_START.recovery: Stop native capture if opened, stop foreground microphone state, preserve diagnostics, permit explicit operator retry.

BCI_E_CAPTURE_LOOP.meaning: Unhandled exception crossed the capture-worker operation boundary.
BCI_E_CAPTURE_LOOP.recovery: Catch exception, preserve root cause, stop monitoring safely; never allow exception to terminate process.

BCI_E_AUDIO_INACTIVE.meaning: Android believes monitoring is running but Oboe reports no active stream.
BCI_E_AUDIO_INACTIVE.recovery: Stop affected monitoring session and permit operator restart.

BCI_E_NATIVE_PROBE.recovery: Treat native boundary as unreliable and stop monitoring.

BCI_E_SAMPLE_RATE.meaning: Native stream sample rate differs from the 44.1 kHz contract.
BCI_E_SAMPLE_RATE.recovery: Stop monitoring; do not feed mismatched-rate PCM into detector/publisher.

BCI_E_CAPTURE_STALL.meaning: Frames captured did not advance for the configured stall window.
BCI_E_CAPTURE_STALL.recovery: Stop monitoring safely rather than leaving a frozen baseline/UI.

BCI_E_BASELINE_STALL.meaning: PCM is arriving but baseline progress is not advancing.
BCI_E_BASELINE_STALL.recovery: Stop monitoring safely and preserve fault for diagnosis.

BCI_E_LIVE_TRANSCRIPTION.recovery: Keep local audio capture and live audio operational; expose caption failure.

BCI_E_BROADCAST.recovery: Keep local monitoring operational; permit reconnect/retry.

BCI_E_ERROR_HANDLER.meaning: Robust error handler encountered an internal exception.
BCI_E_ERROR_HANDLER.recovery: Catch internally, record diagnostic, never propagate into app process.

BCI_W_NATIVE_RING_DROP.meaning: Native PCM ring could not retain one or more incoming frames.

BCI_W_BROADCAST_AUDIO_DROP.meaning: Publisher dropped audio because the network WebSocket queue exceeded the configured limit.
BCI_W_BROADCAST_AUDIO_DROP.recovery: Continue local monitoring and allow network recovery.

BCI_W_BROADCAST_TRANSCRIPT_DROP.meaning: Lower-priority live transcript message was dropped under backpressure.
BCI_W_BROADCAST_TRANSCRIPT_DROP.recovery: Continue audio; transcript is intentionally lower priority.

timeAndUnits.rule: Every boundary must name or encode its unit. Silent conversion between frames, milliseconds, 10 ms Whisper ticks, seconds, Hz, or dBFS is prohibited.

compatibility.backwardCompatibilityRule: A change to a field meaning, unit, required protocol field, sample representation, JNI signature, state semantics, or error-code semantics requires either a backward-compatible adapter or a new BCI Core Contract version.
ciRequirements: Verify Kotlin external declarations against packaged JNI exports.
Verify required native shared libraries exist in the final APK.
Verify ELF NEEDED dependencies resolve to packaged Android libraries.
Verify publisher/gateway protocol IDs and message fields.
Verify gateway CI Bun runtime matches Docker Bun runtime.
Verify robust error handler source and capture-loop exception boundary remain present.
